newsitem.title: ITALY: Schenker Italian unit moves to new premise.
newsitem.headline: Schenker Italian unit moves to new premise.

text.p: Schenker Italiana Spa, the Italian arm of Schenker International said it has moved to new premises at Bandiera, Peschiera Borromeo in northern Italy.
The new headquarters contains four warehouse areas dedicated to palletising and 10 trucking docks reserved for air cargo.

Schenker International is part of the Schenker-Rhenus AG transport group, a subsidiary of trading conglomerate Stinnes AG which, in turn, is owned by Veba AG. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
